LED 네 개를 D2–D5에 연결해 빛이 좌우로 왕복하는 나이트라이더 패: Connect four LEDs to D2–D5 and make a Knight Rider pattern in which the light sweeps back and forth.
여러 GPIO를 배열(포트·핀 표)로 다루는 코드를 읽는다: Read code that handles several GPIOs as an array (a table of ports and pins)
패턴의 한 주기를 단계 수 × 단계 시간으로 계산한다: Calculate one period of the pattern as number of steps × step time
LED마다 저항을 따로 다는 이유를 안다: Understand why each LED gets its own resistor
Four LED and resistor pairs have been placed. Connect them in order, starting from the left.
Each one is **pin → resistor → LED (A→K) → GND**.
LED마다 저항을 따로 다는 이유: LED는 켜지는 전압(순방향 전압)이: Why each LED gets its own resistor: LEDs differ slightly in the voltage at which they turn on (forward voltage), so if they share one resistor, the current crowds into the LED with the lowest one.
D3–D5처럼 핀 번호가 섞여 있어도(PB3, PB5, PB4) 펌웨어는: Even when the port pins are mixed up, as with D3–D5 (PB3, PB5, PB4), the firmware handles them with a single table.
배선 검사 표시 이름에 어느 LED가 틀렸는지 나옵니다. 하나씩 고치세요: The wiring check's display names tell you which LED is wrong. Fix them one at a time.
**▶ 실행**하면 빛이 1→2→3→4→3→2→1… 로 100 ms마다: Press **▶ Run** and the light moves 1→2→3→4→3→2→1… every 100 ms.
한 번 왕복은 6단계 × 100 ms = **600 ms** 입니다. 양: One round trip is 6 steps × 100 ms = **600 ms**. The end LEDs (D2, D5) light once per round trip, so their pins also have a period of 600 ms.
Grading measures the period of the two end pins.
가운데 LED(2, 3)는 왕복마다 **두 번** 켜집니다(갈 때, 올: The middle LEDs (2, 3) light **twice** per round trip (on the way out and back). So their period is not regular — after 400 ms, then after 200 ms.
You can confirm this by viewing PB3 as well in the Oscilloscope tab.
D3–D5를 PB3–PB5 순서라고 생각 — D4는 PB5, D5는 PB: Assuming D3–D5 are PB3–PB5 in order — D4 is PB5 and D5 is PB4 (see the board pinout).
GND 전선 하나에 LED 캐소드 넷을 이어 붙이다 저항을 건너뜀 — 각: Chaining the LED cathode nets onto one GND wire and skipping a resistor — each LED needs a resistor of its own.
`STEP_MS`를 50으로 바꾸면 끝 LED의 주기는 얼마일까요?: If you change `STEP_MS` to 50, what is the period of the end LEDs?
LED를 하나 더(D6, PB10) 늘리려면 펌웨어의 무엇을 바꿔야 하나: To add one more LED (D6, PB10), what do you need to change in the firmware? What is the round-trip period then?
